lesson_title: The Midnight Photograph: the Statement of Financial Position
hook_text: Last week: the movie of your year. Tonight: the photograph at midnight.
clip_script: Last lesson's page was a movie — the whole year's story, beginning to end. Tonight's page is a photograph: the shop frozen at midnight, everything it holds caught in one frame. There's the equipment — not at what it cost, but at what it's honestly still worth. The stock on the shelves, counted. The IOUs in the drawer — customers owing, the tenant's late month, insurance bought ahead. The money itself. And on the other wall of the photograph: who FUNDED all of it — the owner's stake, the loan that quietly grew by its own interest, the suppliers still waiting. Two walls, one frame. And they must weigh exactly the same, because nothing in that shop appeared from nowhere. Everything owned was funded by somebody — you've known that since lesson one. Tonight, that old sentence finally gets its formal portrait: both walls, R38 900. Level.
visual_style: A camera flash freezing a shop interior at midnight; items glowing and tallying on one wall, funders' names tallying on the opposite wall, a balance beam levelling as both hit R38 900.
mood: Still, elegant, a satisfying click of symmetry.
pacing: Freeze-frame open, wall-by-wall inventory beats, closing on the level beam.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and develop the photograph yourself — both walls, one truth.
